correctness.rationale: Using the ordinary (not total) cut condition for KG(5,2), an independent exhaustive check (independent_petersen_check.py and its JSON output) reconstructed the face sets in two ways and checked both complete directed Morse Hasse diagrams. The forward model gives one vertex and respectively 6 six-cells, 6 six-cells, 26 five-cells, (8 three-cells, 12 four-cells), 11 three-cells, and 11 one-cells for k=2 through 7. There are no disconnected induced sets of sizes 8, 9 or 10. At k=5 the two mixed boundary matrices have ranks 7 and 9 and maximal-rank minors of determinant -1 and +1, respectively. Thus the nonzero Smith factors are units. The three-skeleton is a wedge of 3-spheres; Hurewicz identifies its pi_3 with the degree lattice, so unimodular basis changes are realized by equivalences of wedges in the attaching-map cofiber. Unit factors cancel and leave S^3 wedge five S^4. A pure shellable four-complex cannot have nonzero reduced H_3. This verifies the homotopy classification, uniqueness within the stated range, and nonshellability, not the interlevel maps. The supplied verifier and output were treated as evidence, not executed.
